# vergeio_vm_nic (Resource)

A NIC attached to a VergeOS VM. The NIC references the VM with `vm_id` and is matched by `name`. Create adopts a NIC that already has that name instead of creating a second one.

A NIC added while the VM is already running is hotplugged. A NIC created while the VM is stopped is present at the next boot. Renaming the NIC updates it in place and keeps its id and MAC address.

Import with the NIC id, or with `<vm_id>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a NIC to a VM. Omit enabled to leave the VergeOS default, which is enabled.

resource "vergeio_vm" "web-server" {
  name       = "my-web-server"
  enabled    = true
  cpu_cores  = 2
  ram        = 2048
  powerstate = false

  boot_disk {
    name = "os"
    size = 40
  }
}

resource "vergeio_vm_nic" "web" {
  vm_id            = vergeio_vm.web-server.id
  name             = "Web Server Network"
  description      = "NIC for Web Server"
  interface        = "virtio"
  vnet             = 6
  assign_ipaddress = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) - ID of the `vergeio_vm` this NIC is attached to. Changing it replaces the NIC.
- `name` (String) - NIC name, unique on the VM.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) - Omit this attribute to leave the VergeOS default, which is enabled. Set false to create the NIC disabled.
- `interface` (String)
  - `virtio`  (Virtio)
  - `e1000`   (Intel)
  - `rtl8139` (Realtek 8139)
  - `pcnet`   (AMD PCNET)
  - `e1000e`  (Intel e1000e)
  - `igb`     (Intel 82576)
  - `vmxnet3` (VMware Paravirtualized Ethernet v3)
- `vnet` (Number) - Key of the vNET this NIC attaches to.
- `macaddress` (String) - MAC address. Renaming the NIC keeps this address.
- `ipaddress` (String) - Address to reserve when `assign_ipaddress` is true. Omit it and VergeOS assigns the next free address. Null when no address is assigned.
- `assign_ipaddress` (Boolean)
- `asset` (String)
- `driver` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `vendor` (String)
- `port` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) - NIC id assigned by VergeOS.
- `machine` (Number) - Machine id of the VM.
